title: Business application
subtitle: Tell us about your business — we will review the application and let you know.

success: Application sent. We will notify you of the decision.
rewardNote: This is a preliminary proposal, not a guarantee. Final terms are set in a separate agreement.

pendingHint: Your application is under review. This usually takes a few days.
